title: the owner's decisions for the third wave: ten blocked rows unblocked, two ADRs accepted, three standing trade-offs recorded
decision: decision record retained; ADR 0030 and ADR 0031 accepted; no production change of its own
code_state: this record modifies only documentation: the record, its packet, the status lines of docs/adr/0030 and docs/adr/0031, and the ADR index
reason_codes: the first ten rows of change 0651's queue each waited on a human decision; the owner gave all ten on 2026-09-16 together with three standing trade-offs (breaking changes acceptable in early alpha; correctness and safety over performance; most inputs benign)
each decision is quoted verbatim, mapped to the record that priced it, and paired with what the implementing record must still prove, so that the authorization is exact rather than general

proposed ADRs 0030 (lazy OPC part decode) and 0031 (execution-context budgets) become Accepted by decisions 3 and 6; the programme's rule that no code cites a proposed ADR is unchanged, the two records simply stop being proposed

accepted_evidence.owner_decisions: given in the session of 2026-09-16 after the second wave closed; quoted verbatim in the record

accepted_costs.contracts_move: decisions 2, 4, 8, 9 and 10 move contracts (an audit, a durable patch format, the timing of a refusal, a fence's read count, two default policies); each implementing record must state the movement and prove the invariants the record lists
accepted_costs.breaking_api: decisions 1, 5 and 10 change public API; the crates are 0.0.x and the owner accepts breaking changes

known_gaps.not_decided: wave order and sizing, exact API shapes, default values; each implementing record decides and documents its own
known_gaps.adr_amendments: ADR 0006 (original bytes) and ADR 0005 (retained state) are amended by the implementing records of decisions 2, 4 and 5, not by this record

withheld: any performance figure: this record measures nothing
